# PassCyber
> PassCyber gets UK small businesses through their customers' supplier checks: Cyber Essentials, MOD Defence Cyber Certification Level 0, supplier security questionnaires, and penetration testing or Cyber Essentials Plus through CREST-accredited testers. One fixed price, in writing. Run by a chartered management accountant and IASME-qualified Cyber Essentials and Cyber Assurance assessor. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd, company 00598511.

## Services and prices (plus VAT)
- [Cyber Essentials, done for you](https://passcyber.co.uk/#offer): £795 (under 10 people), £995 (10-49), £1,295 (50-249), IASME assessment fee included; renewals from £595; if it does not pass, fixed and resubmitted free
- [MOD Level 0 readiness](https://passcyber.co.uk/dcc): £495 fixed
- [Supplier security questionnaires](https://passcyber.co.uk/questionnaire): £295 each, returned within 5 working days
- [Penetration testing and Cyber Essentials Plus](https://passcyber.co.uk/testing): quoted per scope, carried out by CREST-accredited testers under our management
- [IASME Cyber Assurance support](https://passcyber.co.uk/cyber-assurance)

## Free tools
- [Cyber Essentials readiness check](https://passcyber.co.uk/check): 2 minutes, shows what would fail today
- [MOD Level 0 readiness check](https://passcyber.co.uk/dcc-check): 10 questions from the GOV.UK Level 0 question set

## Facts worth quoting
- A Cyber Essentials certificate lasts 12 months.
- Under the current question set, two things fail a submission outright: a cloud service without multi-factor authentication, and security updates not applied within 14 days.
- The MOD has asked its suppliers to reach Defence Cyber Certification Level 0 by 31 December 2026; it is a request, not a legal requirement.
- Contact: hello@passcyber.co.uk
